rows.specialization: Analysis result production denotes the process for the exact analysis work, method, specimen/property and output specification. INTENDED_WINDOW uses PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION for every requested facet. PERFORMED OCCURRENCE, STARTED and IN_PROGRESS allow PENDING_OUTPUT without an actual result, or an explicitly evidenced ACTUAL_OUTPUT; neither proves completion. PERFORMED COMPLETED requires actual result/output evidence and all finish conditions. Both performed time profiles use this facet guard. Only PERFORMED_INSTANT selects MeasurementEvidence /phenomenonTime/instant; RESULT_TIME needs exact compatible work/facet meaning and never means the ordinary resultTime field or sample time.

Intended window binds the intended report/selection and destination; no existing ingestion result is required. STARTED commences the import, IN_PROGRESS means ongoing transfer/attachment, COMPLETED satisfies defined attachment/verification finish conditions. For performed instant only, RECORD_TIME describes an independently evidenced recording phenomenon selected at phenomenonTime/instant; capture/sync fields alone cannot prove it.
